name: Sliced Ham
description: A simple baked ham recipe with a brown sugar, mustard, and allspice topping.
recipeIngredient: 6 slices ham, about ½ inch thick

recipeInstructions.text: Place ham slices on a cookie sheet.
Mix brown sugar, dry mustard, and allspice together. Sprinkle over ham slices.
Bake in 350°F oven for 20 to 30 minutes, turning once and sprinkling additional mixture on the other side.

keywords: baked ham, glazed ham, sweet ham

_similar.name: Ham Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty ham and potato casserole topped with bread crumbs and baked until golden.
recipeIngredient: 1 cup grated Cracker Barrel cheddar cheese
½ cup Miracle Whip salad dressing

recipeInstructions.text: Mix potatoes, ham, cheese, and onion together in a bowl.
Combine dressing, milk, and pepper. Add to potato mixture and mix lightly.
Spoon mixture into a 1-quart (1 L) casserole dish.
Top with bread crumbs and dot with butter or margarine.
Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.

_similar.keywords: ham casserole, potato casserole, comforting main dish

_similar.name: Cheesy Ham Chowder
_similar.description: A creamy, cheesy ham chowder with potatoes, carrots, and corn, finished with crispy bacon.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large soup kettle or Dutch oven, cook the bacon over medium heat until crisp. Remove to paper towels to drain.
In the bacon drippings, sauté the chopped onion until tender.
Stir in the flour until blended. Gradually add the milk and water, bringing to a boil. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened.
Add the potatoes, corn, bouillon granules, and pepper. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Add the shredded cheese and cubed ham; heat until cheese is melted. Stir in the cooked bacon.

_similar.keywords: ham chowder, cheesy soup, comfort food

_similar.name: Crunchy Top Ham and Potato Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty ham and potato casserole with a crunchy corn flake topping.
recipeIngredient: 2 lb frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
1 (10 oz) can cream of chicken soup, undiluted

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all casserole ingredients and mix well.
Place the mixture in a 13x9 inch baking dish.
Combine topping ingredients (melted butter and crushed corn flakes) and sprinkle on top of the casserole.
Bake at 350°F for 1 hour.

_similar.keywords: ham and potato casserole, crunchy topping, comforting casserole

_similar.name: Ham & Potato Casserole
_similar.description: A layered ham, potato, and cheese casserole cooked in a slow cooker.
recipeIngredient: Cream of mushroom or celery soup

recipeInstructions.text: Put half of the ham, potatoes, onions, cheese, salt, and pepper in a slow cooker.
Add the remaining half of the ingredients for the second layer.
Top with soup and sprinkle with paprika.
Cook on slow for 8 to 10 hours or on high for 4 hours.

_similar.name: Pork Chop & Rice Casserole
_similar.description: A casserole featuring pork chops, rice, and vegetables baked in the oven.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F and spray a 9x13 inch casserole pan with cooking spray.
Put raw rice in the casserole pan.
Melt butter or margarine and sauté green onions and garlic in a frying pan, then mix with rice.
Brown pork chops on both sides and place evenly on top of the rice mixture.
Place a slice of tomato, onion, and green pepper on top of each pork chop.
Pour beef broth over the casserole and cover with foil.
Bake in the oven for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until the liquid is absorbed.
